capabilities: : Use note titles as display text
disambiguation: It only creates inline links and never writes to the target note's properties.
extras: Part of the Vault CMS project. Zeku is a desktop writing app from the same developer (paid, with a 14-day free trial).
intentEvidence: Link As lets you keep your wording and point it at whatever note you choose, without writing anything to the target note.
problem: Standard Obsidian links use the target note's name as the display text, making it difficult to use specific phrases or selected text as the link label.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Link with Alias by Pavel Vojtěchovský.
relations.plugin: Link with Alias by Pavel Vojtěchovský

summary: Link As allows users to link selected text to any note while preserving the selected text as the display text in the link.
